scope: 0911 regeneratively cooled bell nozzle, HALF model (mirror plane z=0 of the STL, NSET SYM at X'=0), STL centre-inside voxel HEX8 2.5 mm + 2-layer raft, flash reading A' with grouped flashes, fast cadence, mechanics on the pyamg GPU V-cycle (MODE=5 lane of 0119-flash-voxel-fast-pyamg.json) -- E10 hybrid-tjit -- E10i: floating voxel islands deferred until connected (--mechanics-island-deferral face, 7ae91c4/2be211e)
purpose: F5 (0911-half2p5-flash-fast-hybrid-tjit-island-face.json) with ONE change: runner.linear_solver.mechanics.mode = free-spd, the 0911 counterpart of 0119-flash-voxel-fast-hybrid-tjit-freespd.json (F2'). The mechanics PARDISO solve drops the pinned unit rows (inactive and deferred-island nodes, base clamp, u_x=0 symmetry-plane rows) and factorizes only the free block as a real SPD system (mtype=2); one factor resident at a time. pardiso_mode stays phase23 so the fallback block is unchanged. Half-model BCs, island deferral (face) and every other input are F5's.

deviations: slab 0.5 -> 2.5 mm (5 flashes x 12.5 real layers)
flash beam radius 1 -> 3 m (part extent 0.45 m)

derived_from.change: runner.linear_solver.mechanics.mode: phase23 -> free-spd (+ purpose / note text)

symmetry.plane: X'=0 (NSET SYM; STL mirror plane z=0, 0.29 % voxel mismatch)
symmetry.thermal: adiabatic: --thermal-symmetry-plane (faces with centroid on X=0 excluded from surface exchange)
symmetry.mechanics_release: --release-anchor-mode symmetry_plane (u_x=0 on X=0 + two in-plane anchors on retained printed plane nodes, rank 6)
symmetry.scan_time: represented_fraction=0.5: scan/hold time = A_mesh/(hatch v)/0.5 (real part), energy = mesh share (unchanged)

mesh.note: tools/voxelize_half.py --voxel 2.5 --cut-axis z; frame (X',Y',Z') = (z, x, y - 150 mm + raft); 129,666 part + 3,072 raft cells, 276,447 nodes, 0.83 M mech DOF, 273 slabs, volume / half STL 0.991

layer_schedule.activation_rule: activate a 2.5 mm slab when its first flash starts; 5 flashes per slab, each carrying 12.5 real (40 um) layers of energy and clock (62.5 real layers per slab); energy per flash per cell mass equals the 0.5 mm reading
layer_schedule.flash_grouping: energy per flash per cell mass = validated 0.2 mm reading

scan.scan_time_rule: t_scan(layer) = A(slab) / (hatch x speed): full-area hatching, contours and jumps excluded

flash.power_rule: commanded(layer) = P x t_scan(layer) / (t_flash x capture(slab))
flash.note: reading A' as in 0119; beam radius 3 m >= 5 x the 0.45 m half-model footprint extent; centre-to-corner drop ~1.4 %, capture evaluated on the mesh per slab

thermal_mechanical.release_rule: raft cells cut (stiffness and locked-in stress removed) + symmetry plane u_x=0 + two in-plane anchors on retained printed plane nodes; bottom Dirichlet temperature held at the preheat value through cooldown

runner.heat_source_note: depth band re-derived for 2.5 mm cells under the vertex rule: cutoff 2495 um (< slab), d = 1570.909 um (5 x the 0.5 mm reading), discrete band integral 1.000000

mechanics.note: 13 rows per flash (2 flash + 6 hold + 5 recoat); one mechanics solve per flash = 5 per 2.5 mm slab

linear_solver.note: Same as F5 except mechanics: MKL PARDISO free-spd (free block, mtype=2, phase 13 once per activation pattern then 23). E10 (2026-09-25): the solver-paper block of 0119-flash-voxel-fast-hybrid-tjit.json (E0j / E1j) on the 0911 half model; everything else identical to 0911-half2p5-flash-fast-pyamg.json (0911-A1, 09-17).
